name: Removable flood barrier
description: A deployable barrier for an assessed entrance.
rationale: Can help limit entry through a compatible opening.
limitations: Needs safe deployment, storage and a survey; depth and structural limits apply.

applicable_conditions: Site-specific depth, duration, groundwater, structural and entry-path survey required. Resistance depth design limits must be confirmed; report assumptions at 0.6 m are not a universal safe depth.
